title: Neo Hook Manifest
description: Schema for Neo plugin hook manifests at plugins/<plugin>/.github/hooks/hooks.json. Event keys use the Copilot CLI lowercase form; VS Code converts them to PascalCase at load time and maps `bash` to osx/linux and `powershell` to windows. Declaring an event in both CLI-lowercase and PascalCase form fires it twice and is rejected by scripts/validate-plugins.py.

version.description: Manifest schema version. Only version 1 is currently defined.

description.description: Short description of what the hooks in this manifest do.

hooks.description: Map of lifecycle event names to arrays of hook command entries.

type.description: Hook entry type. Only "command" is supported.

bash.description: Copilot CLI property mapped to the osx and linux commands. Use ${PLUGIN_ROOT} to locate plugin scripts.

powershell.description: Copilot CLI property mapped to the windows command. Use $env:PLUGIN_ROOT (NOT ${PLUGIN_ROOT}) to locate plugin scripts — ${PLUGIN_ROOT} is PowerShell's own variable syntax and expands to empty.

windows.description: Windows-specific command override. VS Code-native property.

linux.description: Linux-specific command override. VS Code-native property.

osx.description: macOS-specific command override. VS Code-native property.

env.description: Additional environment variables for the command.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds. VS Code-native property (default 30).

timeoutSec.description: Timeout in seconds. Copilot CLI property.
